jobs.location: Perth, Perthshire, Scotland · Reading, Berkshire, Berkshire · Portsmouth · Glasgow Aurora, Renfrewshire
jobs.description: Base Location: Portsmouth, Reading, Perth or Glasgow You'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in the office Salary: £44,000 min - £65,900 max + up to 10% performance-related bonus + a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family. Working Pattern: 18-month fixed term contract | Full Time | Flexible First options available The role At SSEN, we are focused on supporting our customers in vulnerable circumstances. As Vulnerability Implementation Manager, you will be responsible for delivering our Personal Resilience Plan programme, providing personal battery back ups and power cut plans to customers who need additional support to prepare for, and during power cuts. Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, you will ensure a successful roll out of 20,000 batteries to customers, identifying process improvements and efficiencies, and improving customer satisfaction. This is an 18-month fixed term You will Work with customer service teams to ensure customer satisfaction in the end-to-end battery process. Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders to gather feedback to improve the process. Create and manage effective reporting of the full programme. Analyse customer feedback and data, creating accurate data for internal and external reporting, including regulatory reporting. Oversee a team of external telephony agents, ensuring call performance and telephony metrics are met. You have Understanding of customer vulnerability, Priority Services and fuel poverty. Excellent communication skills, with confidence producing clear briefings for senior managers. Experience in programme delivery and continuous improvement, identifying efficiencies within processes to improve customer satisfaction. Strong relationship building skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with contract partners and stakeholders Previous experience in managing budgets or commercial agreements. About SSE SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our team of more than 4,200 skilled engineers, customer service advisors and energy experts keep customers connected to a safe, reliable supply of electricity while investing in and developing the flexible networks needed for our low carbon future. jobs.title: Account Manager, DACH
jobs.description: Accountabilities Act as the strategic lead for a portfolio of enterprise clients, taking ownership of their overall experience from onboarding through renewal and expansion. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, including senior and executive-level stakeholders, to understand their business goals, priorities, challenges, and success criteria. Translate customer objectives into relevant product strategies, use cases, features, and integrations that deliver measurable business value. Lead complex enterprise renewal and upsell cycles from beginning to end, clearly demonstrating product capabilities and business and economic value to stakeholders ranging from business champions to C-suite executives. Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across the customer portfolio, ensuring potential issues are addressed in a timely and effective manner. Identify opportunities for account growth by educating customers on relevant new capabilities, use cases, and integrations. Lead and support effective Quarterly Business Reviews, ensuring alignment between customer objectives, performance, and available solutions. Maintain accurate internal account information and communicate customer health, needs, risks, renewal plans, and expansion opportunities across relevant teams. Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver against customer goals and timelines. Advocate for customers internally by sharing product feedback, use cases, business needs, and opportunities for customer advocacy and marketing engagement. Balance multiple strategic accounts, projects, and recurring responsibilities while maintaining strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through. Requirements: 3+ years of proven experience working directly with large enterprise customers in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, or a comparable SaaS role, ideally within ecommerce technology. Fluent German language skills are required , with the ability to communicate confidently with DACH-region customers. Demonstrated ability to build deep, trusted relationships and influence senior stakeholders, including VP-level and C-suite decision-makers. Proven experience identifying, mitigating, and managing customer risks across a portfolio in a proactive and structured manner. Strong track record of managing complex enterprise renewals and expansion opportunities from start to finish. Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed retention and expansion targets. Strong commercial and consultative skills, with the ability to communicate product capabilities and clearly articulate business and economic value. Experience identifying new customer use cases, features, integrations, and opportunities that can increase adoption and account value. Strong understanding of ecommerce business models, KPIs, terminology, market trends, and common customer objectives. Solid understanding of analytics and statistics, with the ability to analyze and present data related to ecommerce performance, A/B testing, conversion, and other relevant metrics. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to adapt communication and requests for different specialist teams while keeping timelines, service expectations, and customer objectives in focus. Ability to manage multiple enterprise accounts and competing priorities while maintaining excellent organization and attention to detail. Demonstrated ability to quickly develop and maintain strong working knowledge of evolving SaaS products, technical capabilities, integrations, and use cases. High degree of accountability, ownership, curiosity, empathy, and openness, with a continuous-improvement mindset. Strong customer advocacy skills and the ability to turn customer insights into actionable feedback for internal teams. Benefits: Opportunity to work with an innovative technology platform operating at significant global scale within the ecommerce industry. Exposure to sophisticated enterprise customers and senior business stakeholders across the DACH market. A collaborative, cross-functional environment spanning Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Solutions teams. High degree of ownership and autonomy over a strategic portfolio of enterprise accounts. Opportunity to contribute directly to customer retention, expansion, product feedback, and broader business growth. Environment focused on empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI, search, personalization, recommendations, and ecommerce technology. Growth opportunities within a fast-scaling international technology organization. jobs.title: Senior SEO Account Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities Manage a portfolio of approximately 8–10 U.S.-based home services clients, taking ownership of local search performance, account strategy, and client satisfaction. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, leading onboarding calls, monthly strategy reviews, regular check-ins, and performance discussions. Conduct comprehensive local SEO audits, identify performance gaps and growth opportunities, and develop customized strategies for each account. Optimize and actively manage Google Business Profiles, including posts, photos, Q&A, reviews, profile information, and ongoing local search improvements. Implement on-site SEO improvements across WordPress websites, including technical fixes, metadata optimization, content improvements, and internal linking. Build and maintain local citations and directory listings while ensuring consistent and accurate NAP information. Monitor rankings, organic traffic, leads, and other performance indicators using tools such as BrightLocal, Whitespark, Google Search Console, and GA4. Translate SEO and performance data into clear, specific, and actionable recommendations for clients. Support social media planning and publishing for selected accounts when required. Monitor Google algorithm changes and emerging local SEO trends, proactively adapting strategies to protect and improve client performance. Leverage AI, automation, and other marketing technologies to streamline SEO workflows and improve efficiency without compromising quality. Take proactive ownership of account performance, identifying issues and opportunities before they become client concerns. Requirements 3–5+ years of hands-on local SEO experience, with a demonstrated record of improving rankings, organic traffic, and lead generation for local businesses. Strong expertise in Google Business Profile optimization and a comprehensive understanding of local search ranking factors. Proven experience managing multiple client accounts in an agency environment, with a strong focus on measurable outcomes and client retention. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate confidently and clearly with business owners and senior stakeholders. Strong understanding of on-site SEO for local businesses, including WordPress implementation, technical SEO fundamentals, metadata, content optimization, and internal linking. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret SEO performance data and convert insights into practical strategies. Highly proactive, accountable, organized, and self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Comfortable working with AI tools, marketing automation platforms, and technology-enabled SEO workflows. Availability to work U.S. Central or Eastern Time hours to support clients across U.S. time zones. Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office setup suitable for remote client-facing work. Experience in home services or trades such as HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, or landscaping is a plus. Familiarity with BrightLocal, Whitespark, GA4, Google Search Console, or Google Local Services Ads is advantageous. Experience supporting social media management alongside SEO in an agency environment is a plus. Strong commercial awareness and the ability to connect SEO activities with business growth and revenue outcomes. Candidates must be currently based in LATAM or Europe. Benefits Competitive base salary paid consistently in USD each month. Quarterly retention bonuses tied to client results and retention. 15 paid vacation days per year. U.S. national holidays included as paid holidays. 100% remote work from a professional setup in LATAM or Europe. Opportunity to work with U.S.-based businesses in the competitive home services market. Performance-driven environment where SEO expertise has a direct impact on client revenue. Supportive and collaborative team culture. Opportunities for professional growth as the organization scales. Exposure to AI-powered SEO workflows and marketing automation technologies. Opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a portfolio of clients and influence their long-term search performance. jobs.description: About Remote Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.   If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! What this job can offer you This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Senior Account Manager , joining our Existing Business team. In this role, you'll manage and grow a portfolio of existing customers across Remote's full product suite — including EOR, Global Payroll, Contractor of Record (COR), and other solutions — expanding relationships with complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. You'll be a trusted advisor to senior buyers, comfortable navigating multi-threaded deals, and driven to find the right solution for the customer rather than getting stuck on obstacles along the way. As a senior member of the team, you'll also have the opportunity to share best practice with peers and help shape how Existing Business approaches multi-product growth. jobs.title: CX Operations Manager, Tooling
jobs.description: About Remote Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.   If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! What this job can offer you You will own and improve the platforms Customer Experience runs on: Zendesk, Vitally, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of the stack. This is hands-on platform work with real scope. You configure, automate, integrate, and maintain systems used every day by support and customer success teams. You work with autonomy on agreed priorities, use automation (including AI-assisted workflows where they fit), and partner with operations and technical teams when a problem needs more than configuration alone. You will see work through from scoping to production and ongoing ownership: testing changes, communicating with affected teams, documenting what you ship, and keeping platforms reliable as requirements grow. How this role contributes to the department's and company's goals Remote's CX organization depends on reliable tooling: routing that works, automations that hold up under load, and platforms that specialists can trust. This role keeps that foundation solid as the business and product surface area grow. You will help CX scale without adding friction: fewer manual workarounds, clearer workflows, and platform changes that ship with proper testing, communication, and documentation. Strong platform operations also creates the conditions for automation and AI initiatives to land safely. The work sits close to the teams who use these tools every day, so the impact is direct and measurable. What you bring Strong ownership and autonomy: you spot what needs doing, set direction, and deliver without heavy oversight. Hands-on Zendesk experience in a production support environment: triggers, automations, views, groups, routing, macros, and comfort debugging via the API when needed. Platform operations experience in CX or customer success: you understand how support and CSM teams work, not just how admin screens are laid out. End-to-end delivery: scoping, stakeholder alignment, safe rollout, and steady-state ownership after go-live. Documentation as part of how you work. Accurate, accessible docs are part of done, not an afterthought. Sound judgment on when configuration or automation is the right fix, and when the problem needs a different approach. Automation experience in CX: low/no-code tools (Zapier, platform-native automations, or similar) and workflows that hold up in production. Practical familiarity with AI in support and success operations: agent assist, workflow automation, triage or routing helpers, or knowledge-backed tools. You do not need to be an ML engineer, but you should be comfortable working with AI-enabled workflows and knowing where they help versus add noise. Comfort with APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns; able to partner with engineering on harder problems. Depth in Zendesk or a comparable support platform. Vitally or similar Customer Success platform experience is a strong plus. Willingness to work across more than one system in the stack. Clear written and spoken English. Remote-first experience is a plus. Key Responsibilities  Platform administration and reliability Administer Zendesk, Vitally, and related CX tools: configuration, access, and day-to-day operational health. Own intake, triage, and delivery for platform requests from internal teams. Maintain documentation for configurations, automations, and integrations. Workflow, automation, and AI-enabled tooling Design and maintain triggers, automations, and data flows that reduce manual handling and keep work moving reliably through CX systems. Build and run integrations across the CX stack using APIs, webhooks, and low-code tools where that is the right tradeoff. Identify automation opportunities from ticket data, workflow friction, and team feedback; ship practical improvements, not automation for its own sake. Support AI-enabled workflows in CX (for example agent assist, routing or triage helpers, and intake automation): configure, test, document, and iterate with appropriate oversight and change control. Follow change management practices: test before production, communicate impact, document intent and ownership. Continuous improvement Use operational data and platform metrics to prioritize work and measure results. Identify fragile configs, process gaps, and technical debt; address them in a structured way. Support rollout of new channels, integrations, and workflow changes as CX requirements evolve. Cross-functional partnership Work with support, success, and operations teams to understand workflow needs and validate solutions before they ship. Partner with enablement on training and adoption when tooling changes affect frontline teams. Collaborate with product, engineering, and data teams on integrations and escalations that go beyond platform configuration.   Practicals You'll report to: Senior Manager, CX Operations Team: Customer Experience - CX Operations Location : For this position we welcome everyone to apply, but we will prioritize applications from Europe and the Americas. Start date: As soon as possible Application process Interview with recruiter Interview with f
